# Diagnostic Tool Design — Complete Architecture Guide

Architecture and design principles for non-intrusive MongoDB diagnostic, telemetry capture, and log analysis tooling in high-throughput environments.

## System Architecture & Invariants
- [HIGH] (core) Diagnostic tooling must avoid acquiring exclusive database locks or triggering unindexed catalogue lookups during production incidents.
- [HIGH] (methodology) Streaming BSON parsers must enforce strict chunk buffer caps to prevent diagnostic tools from inducing OOM kills on memory-constrained replica nodes.
- [HIGH] (antipatterns) Capturing full query documents without regex-based PII redaction creates severe data governance and compliance violations in diagnostic bundles.
- [HIGH] (patterns) Use query-shape normalization (stripping constants while retaining predicates) to allow deterministic error grouping without leaking sensitive field values.
- [HIGH] (troubleshooting) Symptom: Diagnostic scraper causes replica set election. Cause: Scraper command timeout holding db lock. Fix: Use non-blocking serverStatus with small timeout.

## Primary Sources & Citations
